_purpose: Node-level regression checks for pembangunanSayap. Companion to ground_truth/pembangunanSayap.ground_truth.json, which covers core fields and document-wide invariants only.

_locator_note: Prefer path_suffix (position) over sub_document/node_type (profile labels). Checks whose subject IS a label set requires_label_locators. See md/fix_plan.md phase 0.2.
